public.icash_owner_preflight_due_at(uuid.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_owner_preflight_due_at(p_account uuid, p_screening uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with due as materialized (
  select p.account_id,p.items,p.next_check_at from icash_research_private.owner_export_preflights p
  where p.account_id=p_account and p.state='waiting'
   and p.created_at>now()-interval '30 minutes' and p.created_at<=now()
   and p.next_check_at<=now() and p.deleted_at is null and p.cleanup_attempts=0
   and (p_screening is null or p.items->0->>'screeningId'=p_screening::text)
   and jsonb_typeof(p.list_id) in ('string','number') and (p.list_id#>>'{}') ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}$'
   and p.receipts->'create'->'httpStatus'='200'::jsonb
   and p.receipts->'create'->'raw'->'data'->'list_id'=p.list_id
   and p.receipts->'create'->'raw'->'data'->>'name'=p.list_name
   and p.receipts->'create'->'raw'->'data'->>'source_type'='people'
   and p.receipts->'create'->'raw'->'data'->>'status'='completed'
   and p.receipts->'create'->'raw'->'data'->'total_count'=to_jsonb(
    case when jsonb_typeof(p.request->'people_ids')='array' then jsonb_array_length(p.request->'people_ids') end)
 )
 select min(p.next_check_at) from due p
 join public.icash_screening_jobs s on s.id=(p.items->0->>'screeningId')::uuid and s.account_id=p.account_id
 join public.icash_automation_tickets t on t.screening_id=s.id and t.account_id=s.account_id
 where public.icash_dealmachine_capacity_available(3)
  and t.kind='contacts' and t.state='held' and t.outcome='owner_preview_rate_limited'
  and t.owner_preview_deferrals between 1 and 7
  and t.owner_preview_retry_after<=now() and t.owner_preview_retry_until>now()
  and t.owner_preview_screening_hash=public.icash_owner_enrichment_screening_hash(s)
  and public.icash_owner_enrichment_retry_current(s.account_id,s.id)
  and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_operation_spend o
   join public.icash_screening_jobs prior on o.operation_key='owners:'||s.account_id||':'||prior.id
   where prior.account_id=s.account_id and prior.snapshot->>'propertyId'=s.snapshot->>'propertyId'
    and o.state in ('reserved','dispatched'))
  and p.items=icash_research_private.owner_preflight_cohort(s.account_id,s.id);
$function$

icash_research_private.owner_preflight_c.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION icash_research_private.owner_preflight_cohort(p_account uuid, p_primary uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select p.items from icash_research_private.owner_export_preflights p
 where p.account_id=p_account and p.items->0->>'screeningId'=p_primary::text
 and (p.created_at>now()-interval '5 minutes' or
 (p.created_at>now()-interval '30 minutes' and p.state in ('waiting','checking','ready') and (p.list_id is not null and p.receipts->'create'->'httpStatus'='200'::jsonb
 and p.receipts->'create'->'raw'->'data'->'list_id'=p.list_id
 and p.receipts->'create'->'raw'->'data'->>'name'=p.list_name
 and p.receipts->'create'->'raw'->'data'->>'source_type'='people'
 and p.receipts->'create'->'raw'->'data'->>'status'='completed'
 and p.receipts->'create'->'raw'->'data'->'total_count'=to_jsonb(jsonb_array_length(p.request->'people_ids'))))) and p.state in ('creating','waiting','checking','ready')
 and (p.state='ready' or (p.deleted_at is null and p.cleanup_attempts=0))
 and exists(select 1 from icash_research_private.owner_export_settings where id=1 and enabled and preflight_enabled)
 and not exists(
  select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p.items) i
  left join public.icash_screening_jobs s on s.id=(i->>'screeningId')::uuid and s.account_id=p_account
  where s.id is null or s.snapshot is distinct from i->'snapshot' or s.state is distinct from 'complete'
   or (s.completed_at between now()-interval '24 hours' and now()) is distinct from true
   or s.result->'financialCheck'->>'status' is distinct from 'eligible' or s.snapshot ? 'sellerRequest'
   or s.snapshot->>'propertyType' is distinct from 'house'
   or public.icash_research_state_allowed(s.snapshot->'raw'->'data'->>'state') is distinct from true
   or coalesce(p.request->'mobile_only','false'::jsonb) is distinct from to_jsonb(public.icash_owner_targeting_pool(p_account,s.id)='mobile')
   or public.icash_owner_enrichment_unstarted(p_account,s.id,'owners:'||p_account||':'||s.id) is distinct from true
   or exists(select 1 from public.icash_property_controls pc where pc.account_id=p_account and pc.property_id=s.snapshot->>'propertyId' and pc.manual)
   or (s.id<>p_primary and exists(select 1 from public.icash_automation_tickets t where t.screening_id=s.id))
 )
 and public.icash_owner_export_people_available(p.request->'people_ids')
 order by p.created_at,p.id limit 1;
$function$

public.icash_owner_preflight_sibling_wai.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_owner_preflight_sibling_waiting(p_account uuid, p_screening uuid, p_snapshot jsonb, p_primary uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(
  select 1 from icash_research_private.owner_export_preflight_items i
  join icash_research_private.owner_export_preflights p on p.id=i.preflight_id and p.account_id=i.account_id
  where i.account_id=p_account and i.screening_id=p_screening and i.snapshot_hash=md5(p_snapshot::text)
   and p.items->0->>'screeningId'<>p_primary::text
   and (p.created_at>now()-interval '5 minutes' or
 (p.created_at>now()-interval '30 minutes' and p.state in ('waiting','checking','ready') and (p.list_id is not null and p.receipts->'create'->'httpStatus'='200'::jsonb
 and p.receipts->'create'->'raw'->'data'->'list_id'=p.list_id
 and p.receipts->'create'->'raw'->'data'->>'name'=p.list_name
 and p.receipts->'create'->'raw'->'data'->>'source_type'='people'
 and p.receipts->'create'->'raw'->'data'->>'status'='completed'
 and p.receipts->'create'->'raw'->'data'->'total_count'=to_jsonb(jsonb_array_length(p.request->'people_ids'))))) and p.state in ('creating','waiting','checking','ready')
   and p.items=icash_research_private.owner_preflight_cohort(p_account,(p.items->0->>'screeningId')::uuid)
 );
$function$
